items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: they brought in Ella Mae Morse, and we backed her

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Oh what a good gig. And then they brought in Ella Mae Morse, and we backed her, and she loved the band. Because I knew all of her records, all of her records.
That’s so great, when you’re listening to those records.
